skill.name: dsh-dev-index
skill.description: Look up DeepSeek Harness features and extension points before writing plugins, bundles, presets, patches, profiles, providers, tools, skills, hooks, or UI. Cites the official repository. Do not invent DSH APIs.
skill.whenToUse: Use when the task is DSH secondary development: plugins, presets, patches, profiles, providers, tools, skills, hooks, MCP servers, UI slots, or config keys.

areas.title: Orientation
areas.summary: What DeepSeek Harness is, where package groups live, and the rule that extensions depend on service definitions.
areas.summaryZh: DeepSeek Harness 是什么、包分组在哪、扩展应依赖 Service Definition。

areas.title: Plugin module
areas.summary: The apply/inject/Config plugin contract, Fiber lifecycle, services, and events.
areas.summaryZh: 插件的 apply、inject、Config、生命周期、服务和事件。

areas.title: Bundles, profiles, and patches
areas.summary: dsh.bundle versus dsh.profile, layer order, whole-config replacement, and display metadata.
areas.summaryZh: bundle 与 profile、层顺序、config 整对象替换、展示元数据。

areas.title: CLI
areas.summary: dsh profiles, dump-config, dsh plugin, version exemptions, and git install allowBuilds.
areas.summaryZh: dsh profile、dump-config、plugin 子命令、版本豁免和 git 安装的 allowBuilds。

areas.title: Tools
areas.summary: defineTool, ctx.tools.register, the execution policy events, and PTC versus native mode.
areas.summaryZh: defineTool、工具注册、执行策略事件，以及 PTC 与 native。

areas.title: Skills
areas.summary: ctx.skills.register, SKILL.md frontmatter, discovery ranks, and the skill tool.
areas.summaryZh: ctx.skills.register、SKILL.md、发现优先级和 skill 工具。

areas.title: Agent presets and persona
areas.summary: Declarative agent presets, the unread legacy .agent-presets directory, and dsh-persona.
areas.summaryZh: 声明式 preset、已停用的 .agent-presets 目录，以及 persona。

areas.title: System prompt and request context
areas.summary: ctx.systemPrompt sections, variables, context, and tool schema order.
areas.summaryZh: 系统提示的 section、variable、context 和工具顺序。

areas.title: Sessions and titles
areas.summary: The append-only session log and the single ctx.sessionTitle provider.
areas.summaryZh: 只追加的会话日志，以及唯一的标题 provider。

areas.title: Hook bridges
areas.summary: Claude Code and Codex command-hook bridges and the events they actually run.
areas.summaryZh: Claude Code 与 Codex 命令钩子桥接及其真实事件。

areas.title: MCP servers
areas.summary: Configuration-only dsh-mcp-client bundles and mcp__server__tool names.
areas.summaryZh: 只含配置的 MCP client bundle，以及 mcp__server__tool 命名。

areas.title: UI slots
areas.summary: ctx.slots.inject, slot cardinality, and the dsh.client bundle entry.
areas.summaryZh: ctx.slots.inject、slot 基数，以及 dsh.client 入口。

areas.title: Settings, approval, and permission presets
areas.summary: Settings forms, ctx.approval outcomes, and /permission presets.
areas.summaryZh: 设置表单、审批结果，以及 /permission 预设。

areas.title: Compaction, subagents, jobs, and catalogs
areas.summary: Compaction backends, subagent providers, background jobs, and the generated config catalog.
areas.summaryZh: 压缩后端、子代理 provider、后台任务，以及生成的 config catalog。
